Live burden: The skeptic must establish that the communities generate incompatible lineage claims or substantive discontinuity, rather than merely confirming linguistically unsurprising diversity. Locked score: The strong/competent band recognizes direct relevance and comparative pressure on linear continuity, while preserving reservations about historical substantiation and criteria separating disqualifying divergence from plural development.
